sections.body: Earth's land is split into big pieces called continents. Most maps show seven.
The seven continents are: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia (part of Oceania), Europe, North America and South America.
Some countries teach six continents, joining North and South America, or Europe and Asia. Both ways are OK!
Asia is the biggest continent. Antarctica is the coldest. Almost nobody lives there all year.
The five oceans are: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic. The Pacific is the biggest.
Find your continent on a map or globe. Which ocean is closest to you?
A cheap globe or a free online map makes this concrete. Find where family or friends live.

hints: Look back at the ocean paragraph.
Asia is the biggest continent. The lesson also says which ocean is biggest.
quiz.explain: The Pacific Ocean is the biggest.

hints: Almost nobody lives there all year.
Penguins live at the bottom of the world on a continent that is ice. What is it called?
quiz.explain: Antarctica is covered in ice. It's the coldest continent.

quiz.q: Which one is a continent, not an ocean?
hints: Oceans are water. Continents are land.
'Arctic' is an ocean, but 'Europe' is land. Which one here is land?
quiz.explain: Africa is a continent, a big piece of land.
